##### Project general facts

Kaia Villa Terra Collection is an exclusive luxury residence located on Pearl Jumeirah, developed by Atara Development. This private villa offers a refined coastal lifestyle, combining modern architectural design with natural surroundings and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, creating a serene and sophisticated living environment.

The villa is spread across four levels and features six spacious bedrooms along with dedicated staff quarters and private parking. Designed with a focus on natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor living, the residence includes expansive living areas, floor-to-ceiling windows, and premium amenities such as a private pool, rooftop lounge, home cinema, gym, and spa facilities. The layout emphasizes both comfort and functionality while maintaining a strong connection to the surrounding landscape.

Interiors are finished with high-quality modern materials in a balanced palette of warm and cool tones, creating an elegant and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen comes fully equipped, and the villa is offered fully furnished, providing a complete turnkey living experience tailored for luxury and convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

Pearl Jumeirah is a prestigious and tranquil island community in Dubai, designed for those seeking luxury and exclusivity in a serene coastal setting. Surrounded by the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf, the island offers stunning beachfront living, with private villas, elegant promenades, and direct beach access. Its atmosphere combines the peaceful rhythm of island life with the sophistication of Dubai’s urban lifestyle.

Residents enjoy a wide range of premium amenities, including private beaches, parks, and scenic walkways, as well as access to sports facilities such as tennis courts, football and basketball fields. The island also features nurseries, a mosque, and a variety of restaurants, cafés, and boutique outlets, ensuring both comfort and convenience for families and professionals alike.

Located just 15 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai, and 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, Pearl Jumeirah offers the perfect balance between privacy and connectivity. It’s also home to the world-renowned Nikki Beach Resort & Spa Dubai, providing residents with access to world-class dining, entertainment, and wellness experiences right at their doorstep.F
